moonclerk_new_customer_trigger.description: New payment plan after the first complete scan. Existing records form the initial baseline; polling resumes after a restart. Scans exceeding 4,000 records stop without advancing the saved place.

moonclerk_new_form_trigger.description: New form after the first complete scan. Existing records form the initial baseline; polling resumes after a restart. Scans exceeding 4,000 records stop without advancing the saved place.

moonclerk_new_payment_trigger.description: New payment after the first complete scan. Existing records form the initial baseline; polling resumes after a restart. Scans exceeding 4,000 records stop without advancing the saved place.
